description: Complete the Delta Lake commands for time travel, optimization, and change data capture.
expectedOutput:
When completed correctly, this code will:
1. Query the patients table as it existed 24 hours ago (time travel)
2. Restore the table to version 42
3. Compact small files with OPTIMIZE
4. Apply Liquid Clustering by patient_id and admission_date for faster filtering
5. Clean up files older than 7 days (168 hours) with VACUUM
6. Enable Change Data Feed to track row-level changes
hints: TIMESTAMP AS OF queries historical data by date/time
RESTORE TABLE reverts to a previous version
delta.enableChangeDataFeed is the table property for CDC
learnings: VERSION AS OF reads historical table versions
Liquid Clustering (CLUSTER BY) colocates related data for faster filtering
VACUUM removes files older than retention period
DESCRIBE HISTORY shows the transaction log
